preconditions.description: The number of vectors n and the number of dimensions m are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= k <= 2 for k in k_values)
preconditions.description: Each vector has at most 2 coordinates equal to 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x_i <= m for x_i in x_values)
preconditions.description: Each coordinate index x_i is within the range [1, m].
All vectors in S are unique.

postconditions.description: The size of T modulo 10^9+7 is within the valid range.
The size of S' is between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= index <= n for index in S_prime)
postconditions.description: Each index in S' is within the range [1, n].
S' is sorted in ascending order.

postconditions.expression: all(vector in T for vector in generate_vectors_from_S_prime(S_prime))
postconditions.description: All vectors in T can be represented as a sum of vectors from S'.
No proper subset of S' can represent all vectors in T.
